title: 第9章 熊熊吃几个倭倭头有什么错呢第10章 货郎的赞赏
content_zh:
;;
敖鹏趁着下午敖武高三补课，不在房间，返回了屋子里。
刚出现在现实世界，敖鹏就闻到了一股扑鼻的香气，他打开门，走到厨房。
“妈，炖的啥好东西？”
敖鹏谄媚地给敖母轻轻锤着肩膀。
敖母先是被吓了一跳，“你怎么回来了？”
“这不是放元旦吗？还剩一天假，所以回来了。”
敖母一愣，“你不是说要去和别人登山吗？”
“登了，下山就坐车回家，明天再去学校。”
敖母也没有多想，“你小子属狗的，天生就是好命，家里一有好吃的，你就跑回来了。”
敖鹏伸着脖子去看。
“人参甲鱼汤！”
敖母脸上带着喜色，“你弟弟模拟成绩下来了，老师说若是冲一冲，有机会进重点！”
听到这消息，敖鹏也惊喜道，“小武牛逼啊，比我这个哥厉害多了！”
“快去洗手，等你弟弟回来就开饭。”
因为是星期六补课，所以敖武今天就没有上补习班。
“哥，你回来了？”
敖武看到敖鹏，有些惊喜。
穷人的孩子早当家，敖父死的早，敖鹏在家里面实际上扮演半个父亲的角色，不仅早上要帮母亲推早餐车，学校里面敖武遇到了事儿，也是敖鹏这个体育生大哥出面。
所以两兄弟的关系一直很好。

“嗯，听说你模拟成绩考得不错，如果考上重点，哥给你奖励一万元。”
听到这里，不仅敖武，连端饭的敖母都露出惊讶的表情。
敖鹏现在大二，一万元对于大学生可不是小数目。
“你哪来的钱？”
敖母毫不客气地问道。
敖鹏端起碗说道，“之前我不是在武馆当兼职吗？现在转正了。”
虽然他现在不仅没有转正，还欠了两万元外债。
但是玩了游戏，逐渐成为小超人的敖鹏可不会被这点钱憋死。
想到这里，他忍不住露出微笑。
如果红袖招里面像迎人这样的女菩萨多一点就好了。
敖母也没有多疑，虽然敖鹏学习成绩一般，但是体育成绩确实非常优秀，不然也不可能通过体考。
她招呼两兄弟，“快来吃，这可是十年份的野山参！”
“野山参？”
这下轮到敖鹏震惊了。
敖母忍痛买一些药用人参熬汤他可以理解，但是十年份的野山参他们家肯定买不起。
敖母也说了一个好消息，“我最近找了一份兼职，晚上给别人家做饭，那家是一个小姑娘带一个娃，不容易，我晚上多照顾了那娃，那姑娘心善，家里面炖汤剩下的药材让我拿回来吃。”
这确实是一个不错的好消息。
敖家接连发生了两件好消息。
所以在一碗人参汤中，一家人有说有笑。
吃完晚饭，敖武刷了一会儿抖音。

忽然一个消息引起了他的注意。
连忙喊，“哥，你过来看！”
敖鹏看向弟弟的手机，他原本以为弟弟要主动给他说那个游戏的事情，没想到是另外一个消息。

Ao Peng took advantage of Ao Wu's senior year's make-up class in the afternoon and was not in the room, so he returned to the house.
As soon as he appeared in the real world, Ao Peng smelled a fragrant aroma. He opened the door and walked to the kitchen.
"Mom, what good stuff are you stewing?"
Ao Peng patted Ao Mu's shoulders flatteringly.
Ao Mu was startled at first, "Why are you back?"
"Isn't this New Year's Day? I still have one day off, so I'm back."
Ao Mu was stunned, "Didn't you say you were going to climb a mountain with others?"
"After climbing the mountain, we will take the bus home and go to school tomorrow."
Mother Ao didn't think much about it, "You are a dog, so you are born with a good fortune. As soon as there is delicious food at home, you will come back."
Ao Peng stretched his neck to look.
“Ginseng and turtle soup!”
Mother Ao's face was filled with joy, "Your brother's simulated scores have come down. The teacher said that if he tries hard, he has a chance to get into the key points!"
After hearing the news, Ao Peng was also surprised and said, "Xiao Wu is awesome, much better than this brother of mine!"
"Go and wash your hands quickly, and we'll have dinner when your brother comes back."
Because it was a make-up class on Saturday, Ao Wu did not attend the cram school today.
"Brother, are you back?"
Ao Wu was a little surprised when he saw Ao Peng.
The children of the poor are in charge early, and Ao's father died early. Ao Peng actually plays the role of half a father at home. Not only does he help his mother push the breakfast cart in the morning, but when Ao Wu encounters trouble at school, it is Ao Peng, the eldest brother who is a sports student, who comes forward.
So the relationship between the two brothers has always been very good.
"Well, I heard that you did well in the mock test. If you pass the key points, I will give you a reward of 10,000 yuan."
Hearing this, not only Ao Wu, but also Ao Mu, who was serving the meal, showed a surprised expression.
Ao Peng is now a sophomore, and ten thousand yuan is not a small sum for a college student.
"Where did you get the money?"
Ao Mu asked bluntly.
Ao Peng picked up the bowl and said, "Didn't I work part-time in the martial arts gym before? Now I'm a full-time employee."
Although he has not become a regular employee now, he still owes 20,000 yuan in foreign debt.
But after playing the game, Ao Peng, who has gradually become a little superman, will not be choked to death by this little money.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but smile.
It would be nice if there were more female Bodhisattvas like Yingren in Red Sleeves.
Ao's mother was not suspicious. Although Ao Peng's academic performance was average, his sports performance was indeed very good, otherwise he would not have passed the physical examination.
She called to the two brothers, "Come and eat, this is ten-year-old wild ginseng!"
"Wild ginseng?"
This time it was Ao Peng's turn to be shocked.
He could understand why Ao Mu reluctantly bought some medicinal ginseng to make soup, but his family definitely couldn't afford ten-year-old wild ginseng.
Mother Ao also shared some good news, "I recently found a part-time job and cooked for someone else's family in the evening. It was not easy for a little girl to raise a baby. I took care of the baby more at night. The girl was kind-hearted and let me take back the leftover medicinal materials for the soup at home."
This is indeed good news.
Two good news happened one after another to the Ao family.
So in a bowl of ginseng soup, the family talked and laughed.
After dinner, Ao Wu browsed Douyin for a while.
Suddenly a piece of news caught his attention.
He quickly shouted, "Brother, come here and take a look!"
Ao Peng looked at his younger brother's cell phone. He originally thought that his younger brother was going to take the initiative to tell him about the game, but he didn't expect that it was another news.
